request.style: English, children, female solo voice, piano, acoustic guitar, gentle percussion, warm and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Elijah was a man just like us
He prayed earnestly to the Lord
That it would not rain on the land
No rain fell for three and a half years

[Chorus]
He prayed again with all his heart
The heavens opened wide and gave rain
The earth produced its harvest now
Power of prayer is seen today

[Verse]
A human being just like us
He sought the Lord with deep desire
The drought held fast for long days
Until his words reached heaven high

[Chorus]
He prayed again with all his heart
The heavens opened wide and gave rain
The earth produced its harvest now
Power of prayer is seen today

[Bridge]
Earnest prayer moves the heavens
It stops the rain or brings it back
Like Elijah standing in faith
We seek the Lord in every way

[Outro]
The earth produced its harvest
Rain came down from the sky
